title: Work-tape answers after signed movement
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape machine over Boolean symbols, let $x$ be its input, and let $c$ be a configuration on $x$. For a work-tape index $h$, Boolean direction $\mathrm{neg}$, Boolean blank flag $\mathrm{bl}$, and natural number $a$, the table answer for tape $h$ after $a$ simulated moves in that direction is the blank-symbol test applied to the symbol at displacement $(-1)^{\mathrm{neg}}a$ from the current head position on tape $h$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-tape machine over Boolean symbols
An input word x and a configuration c on x
